card.name: Account and website support text
card.fires_on: Words in web-forum and software text about accounts, logins, passwords, sign-up and version or patch numbers. It fires on words like recover, even, a question mark after 'Not a member yet', or the dot in a version number.

modes.label: Account and login help
modes.description: Words inside sentences about passwords, registering, setting up or recovering accounts.
modes.example: Accounts are free, and easy to<< set>> up.

modes.label: Version numbers
modes.description: The dot after a major version number or the word Patch in software release notes.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are all forms of 'online', so it pushes against predicting 'online' next.
card.plain: It fires on website account and login help text and on software version numbers, and it makes the word 'online' less likely next.
